summary: Initializes one row of a large block-sparse physics dynamics constraint/solver matrix to identity. A switch on a1 (indices 0..33) selects the row; for that row it writes the diagonal element to 1.0 and every other touched element to 0.0. For rows 3+ a contiguous prefix of the row (the elements before the diagonal, and for rows 21/27/28 a second discontiguous block) is zeroed in one sub_58BB10(dest, 0, N) call (N = 24..144 bytes = 3..18 doubles) instead of individual stores. Returns a1 unchanged. The written doubles span 0x008D2120..0x008D3978 and form the diagonal plus per-row off-diagonal entries of the solver matrix. No static caller on the frame path; vehicle subsystem.
